description: The common hop is a vigorous perennial climbing vine grown for its cone-shaped flowers, which give beer its bitterness and aroma. Bines can climb twenty feet or more in a season and die back to the crown each winter. Hops prefer full sun, deep soil, and sturdy vertical support.
